auto_resolved.end_pose_description: Slowly curl your wrist upward against the weight of the dumbbell, then slowly lower it back down. Keep movement controlled and gentle to avoid stressing the healing mallet finger.

auto_resolved.name: Pronation and Supination with Light Weight
auto_resolved.start_pose_description: Sit upright with your right elbow bent at 90 degrees, resting on a table or your lap. Hold a light dumbbell (2-5 lbs) vertically with a neutral grip.
auto_resolved.end_pose_description: Rotate your forearm to turn the dumbbell palm-up (supination), pause briefly, then rotate to turn it palm-down (pronation). Complete the movement in a controlled manner without moving your elbow.

auto_resolved.name: Reverse Dumbbell Wrist Curls
auto_resolved.start_pose_description: Sit upright with your right forearm resting on a table, hand hanging off the edge with palm facing down. Hold a light dumbbell (3-8 lbs) in your hand.
auto_resolved.end_pose_description: Extend your hand upward at the wrist, lifting the dumbbell, then slowly lower it back down. Keep your forearm stationary and control the movement throughout.

triage.name: Ankle Dorsiflexion with Resistance Band
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright with your legs extended in front of you. Place a resistance band around the ball of your foot, holding the ends in your hands.
triage.end_pose_description: Pull your toes toward your shin against the band resistance, creating tension in the front of your ankle. Hold briefly at the top of the movement.

triage.name: Seated Anterior Tibialis Stretch
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright and cross one ankle over the opposite knee, creating a figure-4 position. Keep your back straight.
triage.end_pose_description: Gently press the top of the crossed foot downward and curl your toes toward the sole of your foot. Feel a stretch in the front of your ankle and shin.

triage.name: Dorsiflexion Hold Against Gravity
triage.start_pose_description: Lie on your back with both legs extended, feet pointing toward the ceiling. Keep your arms at your sides.
triage.end_pose_description: Pull both feet toward your shins against gravity, engaging your anterior tibialis muscles. Hold this dorsiflexed position for several seconds.

triage.name: Double Leg Heel Raises on Stairs
triage.start_pose_description: Stand on a stair or step with balls of feet on the edge and heels hanging off, holding a rail for light support. Feet are hip-width apart.
triage.end_pose_description: Rise up onto the balls of your feet, lifting heels as high as possible while maintaining ankle control. Lower heels below step level for a deeper stretch and stronger contraction.

triage.name: Four-Way Ankle Resistance (with towel)
triage.start_pose_description: Sit in a chair with your injured leg extended in front of you. Loop a rolled towel around the ball of your foot, holding both ends with your hands for gentle resistance.
triage.end_pose_description: Perform ankle movements in four directions: point your toes down, pull toes up toward shin, turn sole inward, and turn sole outward. Hold each movement for 2 seconds against the towel resistance.

triage.name: Inversion and Eversion Strengthening
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright with one leg extended and a resistance band looped around your forefoot. Hold both ends of the band.
triage.end_pose_description: Turn the sole of your foot inward (inversion), then outward (eversion) against the band resistance. Perform controlled movements through the full range available.

triage.name: Isometric Achilles Contraction
triage.start_pose_description: Sit with your leg extended and loop a resistance band around the ball of your foot, holding the band firmly. Keep your knee straight.
triage.end_pose_description: Push your foot downward against the band's resistance without any movement, holding a strong contraction for 6-10 seconds. Relax and repeat.

triage.name: Lateral Ankle Stability with Dumbbell Reach
triage.start_pose_description: Stand on one leg holding a light dumbbell at your side, keeping your core engaged and standing leg stable. Focus on the ankle of your support leg.
triage.end_pose_description: Reach the dumbbell across your body and toward the ground in a controlled manner, challenging your ankle stabilizers. Return to standing position.

triage.name: Plantarflexion with Dumbbell Weight
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright with one leg extended and place a light dumbbell on top of your forefoot. Keep your leg relaxed on the chair.
triage.end_pose_description: Point your toes downward against the dumbbell weight, engaging your calf muscles. Hold the end position briefly before returning to start.

triage.name: Resistance Band Achilles Flexion
triage.start_pose_description: Sit with your leg extended and loop a resistance band around the ball of your foot. Keep your knee straight and relaxed.
triage.end_pose_description: Point your foot away from your body against the band's resistance, fully plantarflexing the ankle. Hold for 2 seconds, then slowly return to the starting position.

triage.name: Seated Achilles Stretch
triage.start_pose_description: Sit on the floor with legs extended in front of you. Keep your back straight and shoulders relaxed.
triage.end_pose_description: Loop a resistance band around the ball of your foot and gently pull your toes toward your shin, feeling a stretch in the back of your calf and Achilles tendon. Hold the stretch for 30 seconds.

triage.name: Seated Inversion Ankle Stretch
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright in a chair and cross your right ankle over your left knee, creating a figure-4 position. Keep your posture tall and stable.
triage.end_pose_description: Gently turn the sole of your right foot inward toward your body and hold the position. Feel a mild stretch along the outside of the ankle and lower leg.

triage.name: Single Leg Standing with Dumbbell
triage.start_pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, holding a light dumbbell in one hand at your side. Keep your core engaged and eyes focused on a fixed point ahead.
triage.end_pose_description: Lift one leg off the ground, bending the knee to approximately 90 degrees while maintaining an upright posture. Hold this position steady, using your standing leg's foot and ankle stabilizers to maintain balance.

triage.name: Standing Band Ankle Inversion with Stability
triage.start_pose_description: Stand upright holding onto a stable surface with one leg slightly lifted and a resistance band looped around the forefoot. Your stance leg is engaged with a slight knee bend.
triage.end_pose_description: Turn your foot inward against band resistance while maintaining balance and control. Your ankle movement is deliberate and stabilized by engagement of the surrounding muscles.

triage.name: Wall Calf Stretch with Bent Knee
triage.start_pose_description: Face a wall and place both hands on it at shoulder height, keeping your feet about 12 inches from the wall. Bend your knees slightly.
triage.end_pose_description: Keeping your heel on the ground, lunge forward gently with your front leg bent, feeling a deeper stretch in the lower calf and Achilles tendon. Hold for 30 seconds each side.

triage.name: Wall Squat Hold
triage.start_pose_description: Stand with your back against a wall, feet hip-width apart and positioned about 12 inches away from the wall. Hold dumbbells at your sides.
triage.end_pose_description: Slide down the wall until your thighs are parallel to the ground and knees bend at 90 degrees. Maintain this isometric position, keeping your chest upright and weight in your heels.

triage.name: Dumbbell Bicep Curls (Light Weight)
triage.start_pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, arms at your sides holding light dumbbells with palms facing forward. Keep your elbows close to your torso and core engaged.
triage.end_pose_description: Slowly bend your elbows to lift the dumbbells toward your shoulders in a controlled manner. Lower the weights back down with control, maintaining proper elbow positioning throughout.

triage.name: Gentle Isometric Arm Holds
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright with your affected arm bent at the elbow, held at chest height with palm facing inward. Use your other hand to support the affected arm from underneath.
triage.end_pose_description: Gently press your affected arm downward against the resistance of your supporting hand without moving. Hold this gentle isometric contraction for 3-5 seconds, then relax.

triage.name: Prone Hand Elevation and Relaxation
triage.start_pose_description: Lie face down on a bed or firm surface with pillows under your chest and affected arm resting below heart level. Keep your head turned to one side in a comfortable position.
triage.end_pose_description: Gently elevate your affected arm above heart level using pillows or cushions for support. Hold this elevated position to promote lymphatic drainage through gravity.

triage.name: Seated Arm Compressions with Towel Roll
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with your affected arm extended in front of you at chest height. Imagine holding an imaginary towel roll along the length of your arm.
triage.end_pose_description: Gently squeeze your forearm and hand as if wringing out the imaginary towel from shoulder to fingertips. Release and repeat with gentle, rhythmic compressions moving downward.

triage.name: Seated Tricep Extension with Band
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright and hold one end of a resistance band overhead with one arm bent at the elbow. Secure the other end under your seated position.
triage.end_pose_description: Straighten the overhead arm by extending the elbow upward against the band resistance. Lower slowly with control and repeat on both sides.

triage.name: Banded Good Morning
triage.start_pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and loop a resistance band around your neck and hold the ends. Keep your knees slightly bent and your spine neutral.
triage.end_pose_description: Hinge forward at the hips, lowering your torso while maintaining a straight back and neutral spine. Return to standing by driving through your heels and engaging your posterior chain.

triage.name: Banded Quadruped Reach
triage.start_pose_description: Start on hands and knees with a resistance band looped around both feet. Keep your core tight and back flat.
triage.end_pose_description: Reach one arm forward while simultaneously sliding the opposite knee out to the side against the band. Return to center and alternate sides smoothly.

triage.name: Banded Superman
triage.start_pose_description: Lie face down with a resistance band held in both hands extended above your head. Keep your legs straight and forehead neutral on the floor.
triage.end_pose_description: Pull the band down toward your sides while lifting your chest and legs off the ground. Squeeze your back muscles and hold briefly at the top.

triage.name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Row
triage.start_pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in your right hand with arm extended down. Hinge slightly at the hips with a neutral spine and brace your core.
triage.end_pose_description: Pull the dumbbell up toward your hip, driving your elbow back and squeezing your back muscles. Lower the dumbbell with control back to the starting position.

triage.name: Lat Pulldown Machine
triage.start_pose_description: Sit at the machine with thighs under the pad and feet flat on the floor. Reach up and grip the wide bar with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
triage.end_pose_description: Pull the bar down toward your chest by driving elbows down and back. Return the bar to the starting position with a controlled movement without fully straightening arms.

triage.name: Modified Plank Hold
triage.start_pose_description: Begin on your forearms and knees with elbows under shoulders and knees under hips. Keep your neck neutral and core engaged.
triage.end_pose_description: Hold a straight line from your knees through your hips to your shoulders, maintaining tension in your core and avoiding sagging. Breathe steadily throughout the hold.

triage.name: Posterior Chain Activation
triage.start_pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and arms at your sides with palms down. Keep your head neutral on the floor.
triage.end_pose_description: Squeeze your glutes and lift your hips toward the ceiling, creating a straight line from knees to shoulders. Hold briefly while maintaining engagement in your back and glutes.

triage.name: Postural Correction Hold
triage.start_pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart, chest lifted, and shoulders back and down. Engage your core muscles as if bracing for impact.
triage.end_pose_description: Maintain this upright posture with your weight balanced evenly between both feet, shoulders relaxed but not rounded. Hold this corrected position for 30-60 seconds.

triage.name: Prone Back Extension
triage.start_pose_description: Lie face down with your forehead resting on a small towel and arms at your sides with palms down. Keep your legs straight and relaxed with toes pointed.
triage.end_pose_description: Gently lift your chest and shoulders off the ground using your back muscles, keeping your neck neutral. Hold at the top for 2 seconds, then slowly lower back down without touching the floor completely.

triage.name: Prone Thoracic Rotation with Band
triage.start_pose_description: Lie face down with a resistance band held in both hands extended above your head on the ground. Keep your legs straight and core engaged.
triage.end_pose_description: Rotate your torso to one side, bringing the band toward the floor beside you, rotating through your mid-back. Return to center and repeat on the opposite side.

triage.name: Quadruped Bird Dog with Resistance Band
triage.start_pose_description: Start on hands and knees with a resistance band looped around one foot and held in the opposite hand. Keep your spine neutral and core engaged.
triage.end_pose_description: Simultaneously extend the banded leg straight back and opposite arm straight forward against the band resistance. Maintain a straight line and return to start without touching the ground.

triage.name: Resistance Band Reverse Pec Flyes
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright with feet flat on the floor and a resistance band anchored at chest height in front of you, holding both ends with arms extended forward. Your shoulders should be relaxed and spine neutral.
triage.end_pose_description: Pull the band outward and backward, squeezing your shoulder blades together as your arms move to your sides. Your chest opens and upper back engages fully.

triage.name: Reverse Pec Flyes
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright on a bench with dumbbells in hand and arms bent at 90 degrees, elbows at shoulder height. Your palms should face inward.
triage.end_pose_description: Pull the dumbbells out to the sides in an arc motion, squeezing your rear deltoids and upper back muscles at the end of the movement. Return to start position with controlled movement.

triage.name: Seated Row Machine
triage.start_pose_description: Sit at the machine with chest against the pad and feet flat on the floor. Extend arms forward to grip the handles with a neutral grip.
triage.end_pose_description: Pull the handles toward your torso by retracting shoulder blades and bending elbows. Extend arms back to the start with control, maintaining contact with the chest pad.

triage.name: Seated Spinal Flexion Stretch
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright on the floor or a chair with your feet flat and legs extended or bent comfortably. Keep your back naturally aligned and shoulders relaxed.
triage.end_pose_description: Slowly fold forward at the hips, allowing your head and neck to relax naturally as you reach toward your shins. Feel a gentle stretch along your entire spine and hold without forcing the position.

triage.name: Standing Torso Twist
triage.start_pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart and place your hands behind your head with elbows out to the sides. Keep your hips still and facing forward.
triage.end_pose_description: Rotate your upper body to one side, moving only from the waist and rib cage. Return to center and twist to the opposite side in a controlled manner.

triage.name: Supine Leg Slides
triage.start_pose_description: Lie on your back on a firm surface with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Your arms rest at your sides with palms down, and your spine maintains its natural curve with a neutral pelvis.
triage.end_pose_description: Slowly slide one leg straight out along the floor, straightening the knee while maintaining contact with the ground. Keep your pelvis stable and your lower back neutral, then slide the leg back to the bent position.

triage.name: Thoracic Rotations with Foam Roller
triage.start_pose_description: Lie on your back with a foam roller positioned horizontally under your mid-back at the level of your shoulder blades. Your knees are bent with feet flat on the floor, and hands are crossed over your chest.
triage.end_pose_description: Gently drop one elbow toward the floor, rotating your upper spine while keeping your hips stable. Your gaze follows the direction of rotation as you feel a stretch across your chest and thoracic spine.

triage.name: Chest Press Machine
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright on the machine with back firmly against the pad and feet flat on the floor. Grip the handles at chest level with elbows bent at 90 degrees.
triage.end_pose_description: Push the handles forward in a controlled manner until arms are nearly straight without locking elbows. Slowly return to the starting position with control.

triage.name: Modified Push-ups (Wall or Incline)
triage.start_pose_description: Stand facing a wall or incline bench at arm's length away with hands placed shoulder-width apart on the surface. Your body should form a straight line from head to heels with core engaged.
triage.end_pose_description: Lower your chest toward the wall or bench by bending your elbows, keeping them at a 45-degree angle from your body. Return to starting position by pressing through your hands.

triage.name: Standing Chest Opener with Deep Breathing
triage.start_pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand at waist level with arms extended forward. Your posture is upright with shoulders relaxed.
triage.end_pose_description: Open your arms out to the sides in a wide arc while inhaling deeply through your nose and expanding your ribcage. Exhale as you return to the starting position.

triage.name: Standing Chest and Shoulder Stretch
triage.start_pose_description: Stand upright facing a wall or sturdy structure with feet hip-width apart. Place your right forearm on the surface at shoulder height with elbow bent at 90 degrees.
triage.end_pose_description: Rotate your torso gently away from the wall, keeping your forearm in contact with the surface. Feel a stretch across your chest and front shoulder.

triage.name: Standing Chest Squeeze
triage.start_pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and bring your hands up to chest level with elbows bent at 90 degrees. Keep your shoulders relaxed and down.
triage.end_pose_description: Press your palms together firmly in front of your chest, squeezing your chest muscles. Hold the squeeze for 2-3 seconds, then release and repeat.

triage.name: Supine Chest Dumbbell Fly
triage.start_pose_description: Lie on your back on a bench or firm surface with feet flat on the floor. Hold dumbbells directly above your chest with arms extended and a slight bend in the elbows.
triage.end_pose_description: Lower the dumbbells in a wide arc out to the sides in a controlled motion until you feel a stretch across your chest. Return to the starting position by bringing the dumbbells back together.

triage.name: Anti-Rotation Press with Rotation
triage.start_pose_description: Stand perpendicular to a cable machine with feet shoulder-width apart, holding the handle at chest level with both hands. Engage your core and keep your shoulders level.
triage.end_pose_description: Press the cable away from your body while simultaneously rotating your torso toward the cable. Hold at full extension, then return to start with control.

triage.name: Cat-Cow Mobility Stretch
triage.start_pose_description: Start on hands and knees with wrists aligned under shoulders and knees under hips. Look slightly downward with a neutral spine.
triage.end_pose_description: Arch your back gently while lifting your gaze and chest toward the ceiling (cow position), then reverse into a rounded spine with head tucked (cat position). Move fluidly between positions.

triage.name: Kneeling Band Core Rotation
triage.start_pose_description: Kneel upright with a resistance band anchored at chest height across your body. Your core is engaged and shoulders are stacked over hips with neutral spine.
triage.end_pose_description: Rotate your torso away from the anchor point against band resistance while keeping your hips stable. Your movement originates from the core with controlled, deliberate rotation.

triage.name: Quadruped with Alternating Leg Lifts
triage.start_pose_description: Start on your hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips. Maintain a neutral spine and engage your pelvic floor.
triage.end_pose_description: Extend one leg behind you while keeping the pelvic floor engaged and core tight. Return to start and alternate legs, avoiding any arching in the lower back.

triage.name: Quadruped Breathing with Arm Lifts
triage.start_pose_description: Start on your hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips. Your spine is neutral and core is engaged.
triage.end_pose_description: Inhale and extend your right arm forward to shoulder height while maintaining spinal stability. Exhale as you return to start, then repeat on the left side.

triage.name: Seated Core Engagement with Band Rotation
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright with excellent posture, holding a resistance band with both hands at chest height. Keep your elbows slightly bent and band under light tension.
triage.end_pose_description: Rotate your torso gently to one side while maintaining stable hips and a neutral spine. Return to center and repeat on the opposite side with controlled movements.

triage.name: Supine Core Engagement with Neutral Spine
triage.start_pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor, and arms at your sides. Maintain a neutral spine with a small gap between your lower back and the floor.
triage.end_pose_description: Gently engage your core by drawing your lower ribs toward your pelvis without flattening your lower back. Breathe steadily and hold the contraction for 5-10 seconds.

triage.name: Quadruped with Band-Assisted Balance
triage.start_pose_description: Begin on hands and knees with a resistance band looped around your waist, anchored to a stable object at chest height for light support. Keep your core engaged and spine neutral.
triage.end_pose_description: Extend one leg straight back and the opposite arm straight forward, creating a diagonal line through your body. Hold briefly while maintaining balance with minimal band support, then return to starting position.

triage.name: Dumbbell Farmer's Walk
triage.start_pose_description: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with arms extended. Keep your shoulders relaxed and spine neutral.
triage.end_pose_description: Walk forward slowly while maintaining an upright posture and keeping dumbbells at arm's length. Engage your core and keep your gaze forward.

triage.name: Elbow Extension with Resistance Band
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright with your affected arm bent at the elbow, keeping the upper arm stationary against your side. Loop a resistance band around your forearm and hold the other end with your opposite hand for resistance.
triage.end_pose_description: Slowly straighten your affected arm by extending the elbow against the band resistance. Hold the fully extended position for 1-2 seconds before returning to the start position.

triage.name: Isometric Elbow Flexion
triage.start_pose_description: Sit with your affected elbow bent at approximately 90 degrees, tucked against your body. Place your opposite hand against your affected forearm for resistance.
triage.end_pose_description: Push your affected forearm upward into your opposite hand while maintaining the 90-degree elbow angle without any movement. Hold this static contraction for 5-10 seconds and relax.

triage.name: Seated Elbow Flexion with Band
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright with feet flat on the floor, with the resistance band secured under your foot. Hold the band's handle in your affected hand with your arm extended downward.
triage.end_pose_description: Bend your elbow to bring your hand up toward your shoulder against the band's resistance. Lower your arm slowly to full extension with control.

triage.name: Tricep Extension with Band
triage.start_pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a resistance band overhead with both hands, elbows bent at 90 degrees behind your head. Keep your core engaged and upper arms pointing upward.
triage.end_pose_description: Extend your elbows upward to straighten your arms while holding the band overhead. Maintain control and return to the bent position without letting your elbows flare out to the sides.

triage.name: Gaze Stabilization - Smooth Pursuits
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with your head still and neck neutral. Focus your eyes on a fixed point at eye level in front of you.
triage.end_pose_description: Slowly move your eyes to follow a moving target (imaginary or real) from left to right, then up and down, maintaining focus without moving your head. Keep your gaze locked on the target throughout the movement.

triage.name: Supine Eye Movements
triage.start_pose_description: Lie flat on your back with knees bent and feet flat on floor. Keep your head still and focus on a fixed point on the ceiling above.
triage.end_pose_description: Move only your eyes in horizontal, vertical, and diagonal directions while keeping your head completely still. Track slowly and deliberately in each direction.

triage.name: Neuromuscular Re-education - Coordinated Expressions
triage.start_pose_description: Sit facing a mirror with a neutral expression and completely relaxed facial muscles. Keep your head still and your shoulders down.
triage.end_pose_description: Combine multiple movements: lift eyebrows, puff cheeks, and lift mouth corners simultaneously, then release. Hold the combined expression for 3-5 seconds, focusing on coordination and symmetry.

triage.name: Eye Closure Strengthening
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright facing a mirror with eyes open and a neutral expression. Keep your head still and relaxed.
triage.end_pose_description: Slowly close both eyes together, squinting gently without excessive force. Hold for 2-3 seconds, then slowly open, ensuring equal movement on both sides of the face.

triage.name: Facial Mirror Exercises - Smile
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright in front of a mirror with a neutral facial expression. Keep your head still and relaxed with your shoulders down.
triage.end_pose_description: Slowly lift both corners of your mouth upward into a smile, engaging the muscles on both sides of your face equally. Hold the smile for 3-5 seconds while observing symmetry in the mirror.

triage.name: Lip Pucker and Stretch
triage.start_pose_description: Sit facing a mirror with a neutral facial expression and relaxed lips. Keep your head still and your shoulders down.
triage.end_pose_description: Pucker your lips forward as if to whistle, hold for 2-3 seconds, then stretch your lips into a wide smile. Alternate between positions for 12-15 repetitions.

triage.name: Mouth Corner Lift - Alternating
triage.start_pose_description: Sit facing a mirror with a neutral facial expression and relaxed lips. Keep your head still and your shoulders down.
triage.end_pose_description: Slowly lift one corner of your mouth upward, hold for 2 seconds, then release and repeat on the opposite side. Perform 10-15 alternating repetitions while monitoring symmetry.

triage.name: Nose Wrinkle Exercise
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright facing a mirror with a neutral expression and your nose in a relaxed position. Keep your head still and shoulders down.
triage.end_pose_description: Wrinkle your nose upward by raising the muscles around the nasal bridge, creating creases across the bridge of your nose. Hold for 2-3 seconds, then relax and repeat 10-12 times.

triage.name: Tongue Press and Lateral Movement
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright with your mouth slightly open and your tongue in the center of your mouth. Keep your head still and shoulders relaxed.
triage.end_pose_description: Press your tongue firmly against one cheek from the inside, hold for 2 seconds, then move to the opposite cheek. Alternate sides for 12-15 repetitions.

triage.name: Seated Toe and Heel Taps with Band Loop
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, with a light resistance band looped around the front of both feet. Keep your hands on your thighs for stability.
triage.end_pose_description: Tap your toes upward against the band's resistance, lifting the balls of your feet while heels remain grounded. Then reverse the motion, pressing your toes down and lifting your heels to work the opposing muscles.

triage.name: Seated Resistance Band Foot Flexion
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with one foot flat on the floor and the opposite leg extended with a resistance band looped around the ball of that foot. Hold the band's ends for controlled resistance.
triage.end_pose_description: Point your toes downward and inward against the band's resistance, engaging the foot and calf muscles. Return to neutral and perform repetitions with controlled movement before switching feet.

triage.name: DIP Joint Active Range of Motion
triage.start_pose_description: Sit comfortably with your hand resting on a table, palm down, with the affected finger supported. The finger should be in a neutral, relaxed position.
triage.end_pose_description: Actively flex and extend only the DIP joint (furthest finger joint) while keeping the PIP joint relatively still. Move through the full available range of motion in a controlled manner.

triage.name: Progressive Finger Abduction with Band Resistance
triage.start_pose_description: Sit with your hand relaxed on a table, palm down, with fingers slightly apart. Loop a resistance band around two fingers to be separated.
triage.end_pose_description: Slowly spread the two fingers apart against the band resistance, maintaining proper PIP extension throughout the movement. Hold briefly at maximum separation before slowly returning to neutral.

triage.name: Intrinsic Muscle Activation with Band Loops
triage.start_pose_description: Sit with your hand flat on a table, palm down. Place resistance band loops around each finger, creating gentle downward pressure on the fingers.
triage.end_pose_description: Lift all fingers upward against the band resistance while keeping your palm flat on the table. Focus on activating the intrinsic hand muscles that support proper finger extension and prevent deformity.

triage.name: PIP Joint Extension Isometric Hold
triage.start_pose_description: Sit comfortably with your forearm resting on a table, palm facing down. Place your affected finger in a slightly flexed position with the PIP joint bent at approximately 30 degrees.
triage.end_pose_description: Gently press the top of your finger downward against resistance from your other hand while maintaining the PIP joint in extension. Hold this isometric contraction for the prescribed duration without allowing movement.

triage.name: Protective Finger Splinting Position Exercise
triage.start_pose_description: Sit comfortably with your hand resting on a table in a neutral position. Your affected finger should be relaxed and in its natural position.
triage.end_pose_description: Gently position your finger into the proper splinting alignment, with the PIP joint in slight extension and the DIP joint in slight flexion. Hold this therapeutic position for the prescribed duration to train proper joint mechanics.

triage.name: Resisted PIP Extension with Band
triage.start_pose_description: Sit with your forearm resting on a table, palm down. Loop a resistance band around your affected finger at the middle phalanx with slight tension in the flexed position.
triage.end_pose_description: Slowly extend the PIP joint against the band resistance, straightening the finger joint while maintaining control. Hold briefly at full extension before slowly returning to the starting position.

triage.name: Sustained PIP Extension with Gravity Resistance
triage.start_pose_description: Sit with your arm extended forward and palm facing down at shoulder height. Allow your affected finger to hang in a slightly flexed position beneath your hand.
triage.end_pose_description: Extend the PIP joint against gravity to straighten the finger fully. Hold this extended position while fighting the natural tendency of the joint to flex, building endurance in the extensor mechanism.

triage.name: Big Toe Joint Mobilization
triage.start_pose_description: Sit in a chair with one leg crossed over the opposite knee, bringing the foot closer to your body. Grasp your big toe gently with your hand.
triage.end_pose_description: Slowly and gently dorsiflex (bend upward) and plantarflex (bend downward) the big toe through its available range of motion. Hold gentle stretches at the end of each direction for 2 seconds.

triage.name: Intrinsic Foot Muscle Activation
triage.start_pose_description: Sit in a chair with your foot flat on the floor and toes relaxed. Focus on the arch of your foot.
triage.end_pose_description: Without curling your toes, shorten the arch by drawing the ball of your foot toward the heel while keeping your toes extended. Hold for 3-5 seconds and release.

triage.name: Plantar Fascia Release with Ball
triage.start_pose_description: Sit in a chair with your foot flat on the ground or elevated slightly. Have a foam roller or massage ball ready.
triage.end_pose_description: Roll the ball along the arch of your foot from heel to toe, applying moderate pressure. Spend extra time on tender spots to release tension in the plantar fascia.

triage.name: Plantar Fascia Self-Massage
triage.start_pose_description: Sit in a chair and place one foot flat on the floor. Cross the opposite ankle over the standing knee to access the sole of your foot.
triage.end_pose_description: Using your thumbs or fingers, apply gentle pressure and massage along the arch of the foot from heel to toes. Work slowly along the plantar fascia for 1-2 minutes.

triage.name: Seated Foot Flexor Stretch
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor. Place one foot across the opposite knee to access the sole of the foot.
triage.end_pose_description: Gently pull the toes and ball of the foot toward the shin, creating a stretch along the plantar fascia and arch. Hold this stretched position while maintaining an upright posture.

triage.name: Seated Foot Inversion with Band
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright with legs extended in front of you. Loop a resistance band around the ball of your foot with the foot in a neutral position.
triage.end_pose_description: Slowly turn the sole of your foot inward (inversion) against the band resistance. Hold the end position for 2 seconds while maintaining tension.

triage.name: Seated Foot Rolls
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with both feet flat on the floor. Keep your back against the chair.
triage.end_pose_description: Slowly roll one foot inward and outward in circular motions, then reverse direction. Repeat for 15-20 rotations in each direction per foot.

triage.name: Seated Plantar Fascia Stretch with Band
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright with one leg crossed over the opposite knee so the sole of your foot faces you. Loop a resistance band around the ball of the foot.
triage.end_pose_description: Gently pull the band toward your shin to dorsiflex the foot, creating a stretch along the bottom of the foot and arch. Hold the stretch for 30 seconds.

triage.name: Seated Toe Flexor Stretch
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright with one foot crossed over the opposite knee, exposing the sole of your foot. Gently press your fingers against the underside of your toes.
triage.end_pose_description: Apply gentle pressure to curl your toes back toward your shin, creating a stretch along the bottom of the foot. Hold for 30 seconds without forcing.

triage.name: Eccentric Wrist Flexion
triage.start_pose_description: Sit with your forearm supported on a table, holding a light dumbbell with your palm facing up and wrist bent upward. Your opposite hand assists to lift the weight.
triage.end_pose_description: Slowly lower the dumbbell by extending your wrist downward in a controlled eccentric motion over 3-5 seconds. Lower until your wrist is in slight extension.

triage.name: Forearm Plank with Hand Position Variation
triage.start_pose_description: Start in a forearm plank position with your forearms on the ground, shoulders directly above elbows, and your body in a straight line. Keep your core engaged and neutral spine.
triage.end_pose_description: Maintain the plank while alternately straightening each arm one at a time, supporting your weight on your hands in a modified push-up position. Return to forearm plank and alternate.

triage.name: Supine Wrist Pronation Stretch
triage.start_pose_description: Lie on your back with your affected arm extended out to the side at shoulder height, elbow straight, and palm facing up. Keep your shoulder relaxed and stable.
triage.end_pose_description: Gently press your palm downward toward the floor to internally rotate your shoulder and stretch the forearm musculature. Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds without forcing.

triage.name: Standing Band Assisted Balance
triage.start_pose_description: Stand upright holding a resistance band looped around a stable object at waist height with light tension. Your feet are hip-width apart with one foot prepared to lift slightly.
triage.end_pose_description: Lift one leg while maintaining balance on the stance leg, using light band tension for stability assistance. Your core remains engaged with posture upright throughout the movement.

triage.name: Resisted Glute Activation with Band
triage.start_pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart and a resistance band looped around both legs just above the knees. Maintain good posture with a slight forward lean.
triage.end_pose_description: Press your knees outward against the band resistance while maintaining a half-squat position. Keep tension on the band and return to standing, squeezing your glutes.

triage.name: Finger Flexion with Band Resistance
triage.start_pose_description: Sit comfortably with your affected forearm supported on a table, palm facing up. Loop a light resistance band around your fingers and hold the band's ends in your opposite hand.
triage.end_pose_description: Curl your fingers inward against the band's resistance, making a fist while keeping your wrist stable. Slowly release to the starting position with controlled extension.

triage.name: Finger Isolation and Tapping
triage.start_pose_description: Sit with your hand resting on a table, palm facing downward with the mallet finger splint in place. Your fingers are extended in a relaxed position.
triage.end_pose_description: Gently tap each unaffected finger one at a time on the table while keeping the others still. The splinted finger remains completely stationary in the protective splint throughout the exercise.

triage.name: Finger Resistance Band Exercises
triage.start_pose_description: Sit with a resistance band looped around your fingers and anchored under your foot or held in your other hand. Your fingers are relaxed and slightly curled.
triage.end_pose_description: Extend all your fingers against the resistance of the band in a spreading motion. Control the movement and return to the starting position slowly.

triage.name: Grip Strength with Ball
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright holding a soft therapy ball or stress ball in your palm with fingers relaxed around it. The splinted finger is protected and rests on top of the ball.
triage.end_pose_description: Gently squeeze the ball using your unaffected fingers and palm, keeping the splinted finger relaxed on top without flexing at the tip joint. Release and repeat for gentle grip training.

triage.name: Hand and Finger Dexterity Drills
triage.start_pose_description: Sit comfortably with your hands resting in your lap or on a table. Your fingers are relaxed and slightly spread apart.
triage.end_pose_description: Slowly tap each finger to your thumb in sequence, then reverse the pattern. Move gently and focus on controlled, deliberate movements.

triage.name: Hand Intrinsic Muscle Strengthening
triage.start_pose_description: Sit with your hand flat on a table with fingers extended and relaxed. Keep your palm in contact with the table surface.
triage.end_pose_description: Spread all fingers apart as wide as comfortable against mild resistance, then bring them back together. Perform this movement slowly and controlled.

triage.name: Isolated Finger Lifts
triage.start_pose_description: Place your hand flat on a table with all fingers extended and relaxed. Keep your palm and other fingers in contact with the table surface.
triage.end_pose_description: Lift one finger at a time off the table while keeping the others down. Hold for 2 seconds at the top before lowering.

triage.name: Banded Crab Walk
triage.start_pose_description: Loop a resistance band around your thighs just above the knees and stand with feet shoulder-width apart. Bend your knees slightly and hinge slightly forward at the hips.
triage.end_pose_description: Step backward at a diagonal angle while maintaining tension on the band and keeping your chest up. Continue stepping in reverse, maintaining band tension throughout.

triage.name: Big Stepping Backward
triage.start_pose_description: Stand upright with feet together and hands on a stable surface for support if needed. Maintain an upright posture and forward gaze.
triage.end_pose_description: Take a BIG step backward with one leg, extending the step as far as safely possible. Return to standing and alternate with the opposite leg.

triage.name: Big Stepping Forward
triage.start_pose_description: Stand upright with feet together and arms at your sides or extended forward for balance. Keep your chest upright and core engaged.
triage.end_pose_description: Take a BIG step forward with one leg, ensuring the step is exaggerated and covers substantial distance. Return to standing and repeat with the opposite leg.

triage.name: Big Stepping Sideways
triage.start_pose_description: Stand upright with feet together and hands on a stable surface or extended for balance. Maintain an upright posture throughout.
triage.end_pose_description: Take a BIG step to one side, moving your leg as far as possible while keeping your trunk upright. Return to center and step to the opposite side.

triage.name: Clams with Resistance Band
triage.start_pose_description: Lie on your side with a resistance band looped around both thighs just above the knees, hips and knees bent at 45 degrees, and feet together. Keep your core engaged and head supported on your lower arm.
triage.end_pose_description: Rotate your top knee upward against the band resistance while keeping your feet together and lower body stable. Pause at the top before slowly lowering back to the starting position.

triage.name: Glute Strengthening with Dumbbell
triage.start_pose_description: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in one hand at shoulder height, feet hip-width apart and knees slightly bent. Engage your core and maintain neutral spine.
triage.end_pose_description: Lower into a single-leg squat on the opposite leg while keeping your chest upright, then drive through the heel to return to standing. Performing 10-12 repetitions reduces compensatory stress on the hallux rigidus.

triage.name: Gluteal Sets
triage.start_pose_description: Lie flat on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor hip-width apart. Keep your arms at your sides with palms down.
triage.end_pose_description: Squeeze your buttock muscles as tightly as possible and hold the contraction. Maintain the squeeze for 3-5 seconds while keeping your hips level.

triage.name: Hamstring and Hip Stretch
triage.start_pose_description: Sit on the ground with one leg extended and the other bent with the foot toward your inner thigh. Sit upright with a tall spine.
triage.end_pose_description: Fold forward over your extended leg, allowing your hands to slide down toward your foot. Keep your back flat and feel the stretch along the back of your thigh and hip.

triage.name: Lying Lateral Leg Lifts
triage.start_pose_description: Lie on your side with your bottom leg bent for support and top leg extended straight. Keep your hips stacked and engage your pelvic floor.
triage.end_pose_description: Lift the top leg 12-18 inches while keeping it straight and maintaining core engagement. Return to start without dropping the leg and continue with controlled movements.

triage.name: Seated Hip Marches
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with both feet flat on the floor at hip-width apart. Maintain good posture with your back against the chair.
triage.end_pose_description: Lift one knee up toward the chest while keeping the other foot on the ground. Alternate lifting knees in a marching motion, moving at a comfortable pace.

triage.name: Side-Lying Leg Lifts
triage.start_pose_description: Lie on your side with your bottom arm extended and head resting on it, legs stacked together. Engage your core and keep your torso stable.
triage.end_pose_description: Lift your top leg to hip height while maintaining a slight forward angle of the leg, then lower it back down without touching your bottom leg. Keep your upper body still throughout.

triage.name: Standing Hip Adductor Squeeze
triage.start_pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, hands on a support or wall for balance. Place a small pillow or foam pad between your thighs.
triage.end_pose_description: Squeeze the pad firmly between your thighs while contracting pelvic floor muscles simultaneously. Hold the squeeze for 5 seconds, maintaining upright posture.

triage.name: Standing Hip Flexor Strengthening
triage.start_pose_description: Stand upright facing a wall or sturdy support with hands lightly touching for balance. Feet are hip-width apart and weight is evenly distributed.
triage.end_pose_description: Lift one knee toward chest while maintaining upright posture and pelvic floor engagement. Hold the lifted position for 2 seconds, then lower slowly.

triage.name: Standing Hip Marching
triage.start_pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, maintaining good posture with a slight core engagement. Place hands on a countertop or wall for balance if needed.
triage.end_pose_description: Slowly lift one knee up toward your chest to a comfortable height, then lower and repeat on the opposite side in a marching pattern.

triage.name: Standing Hip Stability with Dumbbell
triage.start_pose_description: Stand upright holding a light dumbbell in one hand at your side, feet hip-width apart. Engage your pelvic floor and core for stability.
triage.end_pose_description: Lift the opposite leg out to the side 6-12 inches while maintaining pelvic floor engagement. Keep the standing leg straight and avoid leaning to either side.

triage.name: Standing Knee Lifts
triage.start_pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and hands resting on a chair back or wall for balance. Keep your core engaged and shoulders back.
triage.end_pose_description: Lift one knee up toward your chest while keeping your standing leg straight and core tight. Lower your leg back down with control and repeat before switching sides.

triage.name: Standing Wall Squats with Pelvic Floor
triage.start_pose_description: Stand with your back against a wall, feet hip-width apart and 12 inches from the wall. Engage your pelvic floor muscles before lowering.
triage.end_pose_description: Slide down the wall into a partial squat, keeping knees aligned over ankles and maintaining pelvic floor engagement. Hold briefly then slide back up, avoiding any bearing down sensation.

triage.name: Supine Figure-Four Hip Rotation
triage.start_pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor, and cross your right ankle over your left knee in a figure-four position. Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the ground.
triage.end_pose_description: Gently rotate your left hip outward by guiding your left knee toward the ground while maintaining the figure-four leg position. Feel the internal and external rotation movement in your right hip.

triage.name: Isometric Jaw Clenching
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright with your mouth closed in a relaxed position and your teeth slightly apart. Keep your shoulders and neck relaxed.
triage.end_pose_description: Gently clench your teeth together with about 50% of your maximum effort, engaging the jaw muscles moderately. Hold for 5 seconds, then completely relax.

triage.name: Lateral Jaw Movement
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright with your mouth slightly open, about a quarter-inch, in a relaxed neutral position. Keep your head still and stable.
triage.end_pose_description: Slowly slide your lower jaw to one side, moving it about one-quarter inch without opening your mouth further. Return to center and repeat on the other side.

triage.name: Postural Neck Stretch
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with your shoulders relaxed and your back supported against the chair. Look straight ahead.
triage.end_pose_description: Slowly turn your head to one side as far as comfortable, then tilt your chin down slightly toward your shoulder. Hold for 20-30 seconds and feel the stretch along the jaw and neck.

triage.name: Relaxation Breathing with Jaw Release
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright in a comfortable chair with your shoulders relaxed and your eyes either open or gently closed. Allow your jaw to rest naturally.
triage.end_pose_description: Inhale slowly through your nose for 4 counts, then exhale through your mouth for 6 counts while consciously letting your jaw muscles relax and drop slightly. Feel the tension release.

triage.name: Tongue-to-Palate Exercise
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright with your mouth closed and your jaw relaxed in a neutral position. Breathe normally through your nose.
triage.end_pose_description: Place your tongue flat against the roof of your mouth and gently press upward with moderate pressure. Hold for 5 seconds while keeping your jaw relaxed.

triage.name: Knee Extension with Band
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright on a chair or bench with a resistance band looped around your knee and anchored to a stable point in front of you. Keep your back against the support.
triage.end_pose_description: Straighten your knee fully against the band resistance, extending your lower leg outward. Hold briefly at full extension and return to the starting position.

triage.name: Knee Flexion with Resistance Band
triage.start_pose_description: Stand upright facing a wall with a resistance band looped around the foot of one leg and held in your hand. Keep your standing leg slightly bent for stability.
triage.end_pose_description: Bend the knee, pulling your heel toward your buttocks against the band resistance while keeping your thigh stationary. Slowly return to the starting position.

triage.name: Knee Flexion and Extension
triage.start_pose_description: Sit in a sturdy chair with your back against the backrest and both feet flat on the floor. Keep your torso upright and relaxed.
triage.end_pose_description: Slowly lift one foot off the floor by straightening the knee, then lower it back down in a controlled manner. Repeat the motion smoothly without locking the knee at full extension.

triage.name: Seated Band Knee Extension
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with a resistance band looped around one foot and held at the other end. Your knee is bent at approximately 90 degrees with feet flat on the floor.
triage.end_pose_description: Straighten your leg by extending the knee against band resistance while maintaining proper posture. Your leg should reach near-full extension without locking the knee joint.

triage.name: Seated Knee to Chest
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright in a sturdy chair with both feet flat on the floor. Keep your back against the chair and your other foot resting on the ground.
triage.end_pose_description: Slowly lift one knee toward your chest as far as comfortably possible. Gently pull your thigh toward your torso using your hands, feeling a stretch in the knee and hip area.

triage.name: Single Leg Squats
triage.start_pose_description: Stand upright on one leg with the other leg lifted slightly in front of you, arms extended forward for balance. Keep your chest upright and core engaged.
triage.end_pose_description: Lower your body by bending the standing leg's knee to approximately 45-60 degrees, keeping your torso upright and weight in your heel. The lifted leg remains extended or slightly bent for counterbalance.

triage.name: Leg Press Machine
triage.start_pose_description: Sit in the machine with back and head resting against the support pad and feet on the platform shoulder-width apart. Knees should be at approximately 90 degrees.
triage.end_pose_description: Push through your heels to extend the legs until knees are nearly straight but not locked. Slowly lower back to the starting position with controlled movement.

triage.name: Seated Standing March with Resistance Band
triage.start_pose_description: Stand upright facing a sturdy chair with a resistance band around your thighs just above the knees. Maintain good posture with hands on the chair for light support.
triage.end_pose_description: March in place by lifting one knee up against the band resistance while maintaining balance. Alternate legs in a controlled, steady rhythm.

triage.name: Low-Impact Cardio - Stationary Cycling
triage.start_pose_description: Sit on a stationary bike with your seat adjusted so your knee is slightly bent at the bottom of the pedal stroke. Grip the handlebars lightly with a neutral wrist position.
triage.end_pose_description: Pedal at a steady, moderate pace in smooth, controlled revolutions. Maintain an upright or slightly forward-leaning posture while keeping your head and gaze stable.

triage.name: Slow Walking with Visual Focus
triage.start_pose_description: Stand upright in an open area near support if needed. Focus your gaze on a fixed point at eye level ahead of you.
triage.end_pose_description: Walk slowly forward in a straight line while maintaining focus on your fixed point. Keep your gait smooth and controlled, using support as needed for safety.

triage.name: Cervical Lateral Flexion Stretch
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with both feet flat on the floor and shoulders relaxed. Keep your spine neutral and look straight ahead.
triage.end_pose_description: Gently tilt your right ear toward your right shoulder, feeling a stretch along the left side of your neck. Keep your shoulders level and avoid rotating your trunk.

triage.name: Cervical Neck Stretches
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with neutral posture and shoulders relaxed. Keep your hands resting in your lap or on your thighs.
triage.end_pose_description: Slowly tilt your right ear toward your right shoulder, feeling a gentle stretch on the left side of your neck. Hold briefly, then repeat on the opposite side.

triage.name: Cervical Rotation with Band Support
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright with a resistance band looped around your head, with the band positioned at your temples. Hold the band taut with both hands at chest level.
triage.end_pose_description: Slowly rotate your head to look over one shoulder while the band provides gentle resistance. Maintain the rotation for 2 seconds before returning to center.

triage.name: Gentle Neck Rolls
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with your feet flat on the floor and shoulders relaxed. Keep your spine neutral and look straight ahead.
triage.end_pose_description: Slowly roll your head in a complete circle, moving from chin toward chest, then to shoulder, back, and opposite shoulder. Move smoothly and gently without forcing the range of motion.

triage.name: Lateral Neck Flexion with Resistance
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright with your shoulders relaxed and neutral neck position. Place your right hand against the right side of your head near your temple.
triage.end_pose_description: Gently push your head to the right while providing resistance with your hand, isometrically tensing the left-side neck muscles. Hold for 5-10 seconds without moving.

triage.name: Lateral Neck Flexion Stretch - Unaffected Side
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright with neutral spine and shoulders relaxed at rest. Place one hand on top of your head for gentle assistance.
triage.end_pose_description: Slowly tilt your head toward the unaffected side, using light pressure from your hand to deepen the stretch. Feel the stretch along the opposite side of your neck where the torticollis muscle is tight.

triage.name: Gentle Neck Flexion Stretch
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright with shoulders relaxed and spine neutral. Place hands gently at the back of your head.
triage.end_pose_description: Slowly lower your chin toward your chest, allowing the weight of your hands to provide gentle traction. Hold the stretch without forcing any movement.

triage.name: Neck Retraction
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with shoulders relaxed and eyes facing forward. Keep your chin level and parallel to the ground.
triage.end_pose_description: Gently draw your chin straight backward, creating a double chin appearance. Hold this retracted position while keeping your gaze forward.

triage.name: Neck Rotation Stretch - Supine
triage.start_pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Keep your head in neutral position resting on a low pillow or towel roll.
triage.end_pose_description: Gently rotate your head toward the unaffected side, allowing gravity to assist in the stretch. Hold this position to release tension in the affected sternocleidomastoid muscle.

triage.name: Neck Stretching - Sternocleidomastoid
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright with good posture and shoulders relaxed. Keep your chin level and face forward.
triage.end_pose_description: Gently tilt your head toward the unaffected side (away from the tight muscle) while slightly rotating your chin upward. Hold this position to feel a stretch along the front and side of the affected neck.

triage.name: Prone Head Turns
triage.start_pose_description: Lie face down on a firm surface with your forehead resting on a small rolled towel or pillow. Keep your arms relaxed alongside your body.
triage.end_pose_description: Slowly turn your head to one side, resting your cheek on the support while avoiding excessive rotation. Pause briefly, then turn to the opposite side in a controlled manner.

triage.name: Bridging with Pelvic Floor Engagement
triage.start_pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and arms at your sides. Engage your pelvic floor muscles before initiating movement.
triage.end_pose_description: Lift your hips toward the ceiling while maintaining pelvic floor engagement and glute contraction. Hold briefly at the top while maintaining steady breathing.

triage.name: Cat-Cow Mobilization
triage.start_pose_description: Start on your hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips. Spine is in neutral position with gaze toward the ground.
triage.end_pose_description: Arch your back gently, lifting your gaze and chest toward the ceiling (cow), then reverse by rounding your spine and tucking your chin (cat). Move slowly with deep breathing to encourage pelvic floor relaxation.

triage.name: Deep Squat Hold with Relaxation
triage.start_pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, weight distributed evenly through both feet. Hands can be held in front for light support if needed.
triage.end_pose_description: Slowly lower into a deep squat position with weight in your heels, allowing your pelvic floor to relax and lengthen. Breathe deeply and hold this position for 20-30 seconds.

triage.name: Pelvic Floor Exercises (Kegels)
triage.start_pose_description: Sit comfortably in a chair with your back supported and feet flat on the floor. Relax your abdominal, buttock, and thigh muscles completely.
triage.end_pose_description: Contract your pelvic floor muscles (the muscles you use to stop urination midstream) for 3-5 seconds, then fully relax for the same duration. Maintain normal breathing throughout.

triage.name: Quadruped Pelvic Floor Hold
triage.start_pose_description: Position yourself on hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips. Maintain a neutral spine with core gently engaged.
triage.end_pose_description: Contract the pelvic floor muscles strongly while maintaining stable quadruped position for 5 seconds. Keep breathing steady and avoid holding your breath.

triage.name: Seated Kegel with Posture Hold
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright on a chair with feet flat on the floor and good posture, maintaining neutral spine. Relax your breathing and prepare to engage the pelvic floor.
triage.end_pose_description: Contract your pelvic floor muscles for 5-8 seconds while maintaining upright posture and relaxed breathing. Release and rest for equal duration between repetitions.

triage.name: Seated Pelvic Floor Awareness
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright on a chair with feet flat on the floor and knees at 90 degrees. Maintain good posture with a neutral spine.
triage.end_pose_description: Practice gentle contractions and releases of the pelvic floor muscles, imagining stopping the flow of urination. Maintain relaxation between contractions and focus on slow, controlled movements.

triage.name: 4-7-8 Breathing Pattern
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright in a comfortable position with your spine neutral and shoulders relaxed. Rest your hands on your thighs.
triage.end_pose_description: Inhale through your nose for 4 counts, hold for 7 counts, then exhale through your mouth for 8 counts. Repeat the pattern for 4 complete cycles.

triage.name: Side-Lying Ribcage Expansion
triage.start_pose_description: Lie on your left side with your left arm extended on the ground and right arm resting on your torso. Your hips and shoulders are stacked.
triage.end_pose_description: Inhale deeply while opening your right arm up and back, rotating your ribcage and thorax toward the ceiling. Exhale as you return your arm to your torso.

triage.name: Arm Elevation with Deep Breathing
triage.start_pose_description: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart and arms relaxed at your sides. Keep your shoulders relaxed and take a deep breath in through your nose.
triage.end_pose_description: Slowly raise both arms out to the sides and overhead in a smooth arc while exhaling. Hold this elevated position briefly, then lower arms back down as you inhale.

triage.name: Banded Internal Rotation at 90/90
triage.start_pose_description: Stand with your right arm raised to 90 degrees at the shoulder and bent 90 degrees at the elbow, holding a resistance band. Your forearm points upward and slightly back.
triage.end_pose_description: Rotate your forearm forward and downward against band resistance, bringing it toward your midline. Your upper arm and elbow remain fixed at 90 degrees throughout the movement.

triage.name: Banded Shoulder Stabilization
triage.start_pose_description: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart and a resistance band looped around both wrists at chest height. Your arms are extended forward with a slight bend in the elbows, maintaining neutral posture.
triage.end_pose_description: Pull the band apart by moving your arms outward in a controlled motion, engaging your shoulder stabilizers. Your arms remain at chest height with elbows slightly bent as you create tension in the band.

triage.name: Banded Triceps Extension
triage.start_pose_description: Stand on one end of a resistance band with feet shoulder-width apart and hold the other end at shoulder height with your elbow bent. Keep your elbow close to your torso and upper arm stationary.
triage.end_pose_description: Extend your arm upward and slightly forward, straightening the elbow against the band resistance until your arm is nearly fully extended. Lower back to the starting position with controlled tension throughout.

triage.name: Big Head Turns
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with your head facing forward and shoulders relaxed. Keep your trunk stable and only move your head.
triage.end_pose_description: Turn your head as far as possible to one side in a BIG, exaggerated motion. Return to center and rotate to the opposite side with maximum range.

triage.name: Big Reaching Overhead
triage.start_pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms resting at your sides. Keep your posture upright with your core engaged.
triage.end_pose_description: Reach both arms BIG and high overhead, fully extending through your shoulders and standing tall on your toes if possible. Hold briefly at the top before lowering.

triage.name: Breathing Exercises with Arm Positioning
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright in a comfortable chair with both feet flat on the floor and arms resting on your thighs. Close your eyes or maintain a soft gaze.
triage.end_pose_description: Slowly raise both arms out to shoulder height while inhaling deeply for a count of 4. Lower arms while exhaling slowly for a count of 4, promoting lymphatic circulation.

triage.name: Crossbody Shoulder Stretch
triage.start_pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart and shoulders relaxed, with your affected arm hanging naturally at your side. Maintain an upright posture with your core engaged and gaze forward.
triage.end_pose_description: Use your opposite hand to gently grasp the elbow or upper arm of the affected side and pull it across your body toward your chest. Hold this position while maintaining an upright posture, feeling the stretch across the back of the shoulder and upper back.

triage.name: Doorway Pectoralis Stretch
triage.start_pose_description: Stand in a doorway with your affected elbow bent to 90 degrees and forearm against the doorframe at shoulder height. Step one foot forward.
triage.end_pose_description: Gently lean your body forward, stretching your pectoralis muscle and anterior shoulder. Hold for 20-30 seconds without exceeding comfortable range of motion.

triage.name: Dumbbell Farmer's Carries
triage.start_pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with neutral wrist and shoulder position. Engage your core and maintain tall posture.
triage.end_pose_description: Walk forward maintaining upright posture, shoulders level, and neutral neck alignment. Focus on keeping both shoulders balanced and avoiding lateral neck flexion throughout the movement.

triage.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Presses
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright with your back against a bench or chair, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height with elbows bent. Your core is engaged and your feet are flat on the floor.
triage.end_pose_description: Press the dumbbells overhead in a controlled motion until your arms are nearly fully extended. Lower them back to shoulder height with control.

triage.name: Gentle Shoulder Circles
triage.start_pose_description: Stand with good posture, feet shoulder-width apart, and arms hanging naturally at your sides. Keep your neck neutral and gaze forward.
triage.end_pose_description: Slowly rotate both shoulders backward in small circles, moving up toward your ears, back, and down. Complete 8-10 circles, then reverse direction.

triage.name: Half-Kneeling Single-Arm Row with Band
triage.start_pose_description: Kneel on your right knee with left foot forward, holding a resistance band anchored at chest height in front of you. Your arm is extended straight out with the band at medium tension.
triage.end_pose_description: Pull the band toward your ribcage by driving your elbow back, squeezing your shoulder blade toward your spine. Your torso remains upright and stable with minimal rotation.

triage.name: Lightweight Lateral Raises
triage.start_pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, holding light dumbbells at your sides with a neutral grip. Engage your core and keep shoulders down.
triage.end_pose_description: Raise both arms out to the sides in a slow, controlled motion until they reach shoulder height. Maintain a slight bend in your elbows throughout the movement.

triage.name: Overhead Dumbbell Press
triage.start_pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding dumbbells at shoulder height with elbows bent at 90 degrees and palms facing forward. Engage your core and maintain neutral spine alignment.
triage.end_pose_description: Press the dumbbells overhead, extending your arms fully while maintaining control. Keep your core tight and avoid arching your lower back excessively.

triage.name: Prone Reverse Fly
triage.start_pose_description: Lie face down on an incline bench or floor with light dumbbells in each hand, arms hanging down with a slight elbow bend. Keep your forehead neutral and core engaged.
triage.end_pose_description: Raise both dumbbells out to the sides in a controlled arc, leading with your elbows and squeezing your rear delts. Pause briefly at shoulder height before lowering back down.

triage.name: Prone Scapular Y-Raises with Band
triage.start_pose_description: Lie face down on a comfortable surface with arms at your sides holding a light resistance band. Keep your forehead on a small pillow to maintain neutral cervical spine.
triage.end_pose_description: Raise both arms overhead in a Y-position while engaging your lower trapezius. Hold briefly at the top before lowering, avoiding excessive shoulder strain.

triage.name: Prone Shoulder Y-T-I with Band
triage.start_pose_description: Lie face down on a mat with your arms at your sides and forehead resting on the mat. Loop a resistance band around both wrists.
triage.end_pose_description: Raise both arms forward into a Y position overhead, then to a T position out to the sides, then along your body in an I position. Each position should involve squeezing your back muscles against the band resistance.

triage.name: Resistance Band Chest Opener
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright with good posture and hold a resistance band at shoulder width in front of your chest with arms extended. Keep your core engaged and shoulders relaxed.
triage.end_pose_description: Slowly pull the band apart by moving your hands outward and back, opening your chest and engaging your upper back. Pause briefly while maintaining tension in the band.

triage.name: Resistance Band Face Pulls
triage.start_pose_description: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, holding a resistance band anchored at eye level with both hands, arms extended forward. The band should be taut with slight tension.
triage.end_pose_description: Pull the band toward your face, separating your hands as they approach, with elbows high and wide. Your shoulder blades squeeze together as the band reaches near your temples.

triage.name: Resistance Band Shoulder Pull-Apart
triage.start_pose_description: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart holding a resistance band at chest height with both hands, arms straight and band taut. Keep your core engaged and shoulders relaxed.
triage.end_pose_description: Pull the band apart by moving your hands outward, squeezing your shoulder blades together at the peak of the movement. Return to the starting position in a controlled manner.

triage.name: Reverse Machine Fly
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright at a reverse fly machine with your chest against the pad and feet flat on the ground. Grip the handles with a neutral grip at shoulder height.
triage.end_pose_description: Pull the handles back in a wide arc, squeezing your shoulder blades together and opening your chest. Your arms should form a wide V-shape at the end of the movement.

triage.name: Scapular Rows with Band
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright with a resistance band looped around a fixed point at shoulder height in front of you. Hold both ends of the band with arms extended forward at shoulder width.
triage.end_pose_description: Pull the band toward your chest by squeezing your shoulder blades together, keeping your arms at shoulder height. Your elbows should move back slightly past your torso.

triage.name: Seated Arm Lifts
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright in a firm chair with your feet flat on the floor and arms relaxed at your sides with elbows bent at 90 degrees. Keep your shoulders relaxed and chest open.
triage.end_pose_description: Slowly raise both arms up toward shoulder height with elbows bent, lifting hands toward your armpits. Lower your arms back down with control and repeat.

triage.name: Seated Neck Relaxation
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright with shoulders relaxed and looking straight ahead. Keep your back tall and your hands resting on your thighs.
triage.end_pose_description: Slowly drop your right ear toward your right shoulder, feeling a gentle stretch along the left side of your neck. Breathe deeply and hold before returning to center.

triage.name: Seated Scapular Stabilization
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright with good posture and feet flat on the floor. Hold a resistance band anchored at chest height with both hands, elbows bent at 90 degrees.
triage.end_pose_description: Gently press the band forward and slightly outward while squeezing your shoulder blades together. Hold this contraction for 2-3 seconds without hyperextending your shoulders.

triage.name: Seated Shoulder Blade Retractions
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright on a firm chair with your feet flat on the floor, your arms bent at 90 degrees with elbows at your sides, and palms facing forward. Maintain good posture and keep your shoulders relaxed.
triage.end_pose_description: Gently pull your elbows backward, squeezing your shoulder blades together while keeping your arms bent at 90 degrees. Hold this contraction briefly, then slowly return your arms to the starting position without letting your shoulders shrug upward.

triage.name: Seated Shoulder Rows with Band
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with a resistance band looped around a fixed point at shoulder height in front of you. Hold both ends of the band with arms extended forward at shoulder level.
triage.end_pose_description: Pull the band toward your chest, bending your elbows and squeezing your shoulder blades together. Keep your back straight and return to start with controlled motion.

triage.name: Seated Shoulder Shrug with Dumbbells
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and dumbbells held at your sides with arms extended. Allow your shoulders to relax in a neutral position.
triage.end_pose_description: Raise your shoulders up toward your ears in a controlled shrugging motion, squeezing the trapezius muscles. Lower your shoulders back down to the starting position without dropping abruptly.

triage.name: Shoulder Shrug and Release
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright with arms at your sides and shoulders in a relaxed position. Keep your neck neutral and eyes forward.
triage.end_pose_description: Lift both shoulders up toward your ears in a shrug position, then release them downward with control. Allow the shoulders to drop back to their natural resting position.

triage.name: Sidelying External Rotation with Band
triage.start_pose_description: Lie on your left side with your right shoulder flexed to 90 degrees and elbow bent to 90 degrees. Hold a resistance band with your right hand at chest level.
triage.end_pose_description: Externally rotate your shoulder by rotating your forearm upward against the band resistance. Keep your elbow fixed at your ribs and control the return to starting position.

triage.name: Standing Cable External Rotation with Arm at 90 Degrees
triage.start_pose_description: Stand sideways to a cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart, elbow bent at 90 degrees and arm raised to shoulder height. Hold the cable handle with a neutral grip.
triage.end_pose_description: Rotate your forearm backward in an external rotation movement, creating resistance against the cable while maintaining your elbow position.

triage.name: Supine Arm Slides
triage.start_pose_description: Lie on your back on a firm surface with both arms at your sides, palms facing down. Keep your knees slightly bent with feet flat on the floor for comfort.
triage.end_pose_description: Slowly slide both arms overhead along the floor in a snow-angel motion, raising them above your head. Gently slide arms back down to your sides in a controlled manner.

triage.name: Supine Shoulder Stretch with Band
triage.start_pose_description: Lie on your back with both arms extended above your chest, holding the resistance band with a wide grip. Keep your shoulders relaxed and your lower back neutral.
triage.end_pose_description: Slowly pull the band apart horizontally across your chest, feeling a stretch across your shoulders and chest. Hold the stretch gently while maintaining steady breathing.

triage.name: Seated Knee Lifts
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright in a firm chair with your back against the backrest and both feet flat on the floor. Keep your hands on your thighs or the sides of the chair.
triage.end_pose_description: Straighten one leg by lifting your foot up while keeping your thigh on the chair, fully extending your knee. Lower your foot back down and repeat on the opposite leg.

triage.name: Thumb Abduction Against Resistance
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright with your hand flat on a table, palm down. Your thumb is positioned close to your index finger in a neutral position.
triage.end_pose_description: Lift your thumb away from your index finger against light resistance from a therapy band or your opposite hand. Hold at end range for 2 seconds before returning.

triage.name: Thumb Abduction Stretch
triage.start_pose_description: Sit with your forearm resting on a table with your palm facing down. Your hand is relaxed in a neutral position.
