triage.end_pose_description: Using your other hand, gently pull your thumb away from your fingers into a wide abduction position. Hold the stretch gently without forcing the joint.

triage.name: Thumb Adduction Strengthening
triage.start_pose_description: Sit with your hand flat on a table, palm down, with your thumb abducted away from your index finger. Place a soft object like a foam ball between thumb and palm.
triage.end_pose_description: Press your thumb inward against the resistance, squeezing the object gently. Hold for 3 seconds, focusing on controlled activation of the thumb muscles.

triage.name: Thumb CMC Joint Stabilization
triage.start_pose_description: Sit with your hand resting palm-up on a table. Your thumb is relaxed and positioned naturally away from your fingers.
triage.end_pose_description: Press your thumb firmly into the table surface and hold for 5 seconds without moving. Relax and repeat, maintaining gentle pressure throughout.

triage.name: Thumb IP Joint Flexion Isometric
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright with your forearm supported on a table, palm facing up. Your affected thumb is extended straight out with fingers relaxed.
triage.end_pose_description: Gently bend only the tip joint of your thumb while pressing against mild resistance from your opposite hand. Hold this isometric contraction for 5 seconds without allowing movement.

triage.name: Thumb Isometric Stabilization
triage.start_pose_description: Sit with your forearm supported and your hand open on a table. Place your other hand's index finger against the side of your thumb.
triage.end_pose_description: Press your thumb firmly against the resistance of your other hand without moving. Hold for 5 seconds, then release and rest.

triage.name: Thumb MCP Joint Flexion Strengthening
triage.start_pose_description: Sit with your forearm supported on a table, palm facing down. Your thumb is extended straight out from your hand with other fingers relaxed.
triage.end_pose_description: Curl your thumb downward at the middle knuckle joint, bending it across your palm. Hold this position briefly, then return to start maintaining control throughout.

triage.name: Prone Shoulder Blade Retraction
triage.start_pose_description: Lie face down on a mat with arms at your sides, palms down, and legs extended. Rest your forehead on a small towel to keep your neck neutral.
triage.end_pose_description: Lift your chest slightly off the ground while squeezing your shoulder blades together and back. Keep your neck in neutral position and hold for 2 seconds.

triage.name: Reverse Snow Angels
triage.start_pose_description: Lie face-down on a bed or mat with arms at your sides and forehead resting on a small pillow. Keep your legs straight and relaxed.
triage.end_pose_description: Raise your arms out to the sides in a snow angel motion, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Your arms should form a 'T' shape with your body.

triage.name: Finger Isolation Flexion
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright with your hand resting on a table, palm facing down with fingers extended. Your wrist is in a neutral position.
triage.end_pose_description: Curl each finger individually into your palm one at a time, starting with the thumb, then release. Move slowly and deliberately through each finger.

triage.name: Forearm Plank with Wrist Awareness
triage.start_pose_description: Lie face down with your forearms on the ground, elbows directly under your shoulders. Your body is straight from head to heels, supported on your forearms and toes.
triage.end_pose_description: Hold your body in a straight line, distributing weight evenly through your forearms and hands. Maintain neutral wrist position without excessive flexion or extension.

triage.name: Grip Relaxation Technique
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright with your arms resting on a table in front of you. Make a gentle fist with both hands, lightly squeezing your fingers into your palms.
triage.end_pose_description: Slowly open your hands fully, spreading all fingers wide apart and relaxing completely. Hold this open, relaxed position for 3-5 seconds before repeating.

triage.name: Grip Strength Training with Adjustable Gripper
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright with your arm relaxed at your side, holding an adjustable hand gripper in your right hand in the open position. Your fingers are extended.
triage.end_pose_description: Squeeze the gripper handles together using your grip strength, hold for 2 seconds, then slowly release. Keep your wrist in a neutral position throughout the movement.

triage.name: Isometric Thumb Abduction
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright with your forearm resting on a table, palm facing up. Your thumb is extended away from your fingers in a relaxed position.
triage.end_pose_description: Press your thumb firmly away from your fingers against resistance from your opposite hand, holding steady without movement. Maintain the contraction for 5 seconds.

triage.name: Wrist Extension with Thumb
triage.start_pose_description: Sit upright with your forearm resting on a table, palm facing down. Your wrist and thumb are in a neutral, relaxed position.
triage.end_pose_description: Slowly lift your hand upward at the wrist, extending it gently while keeping your forearm on the table. Move through a comfortable range without forcing the motion.
